improvement_suggestions: Gain practical experience or complete projects focused on MLOps, model deployment, and scaling ML systems (e.g., using MLflow, Airflow, Kubernetes, Flask/FastAPI).
Quantify achievements in internships and projects with specific metrics (e.g., 'improved accuracy by X%', 'reduced processing time by Y%').
Provide GitHub links for all projects to allow recruiters to review code and contributions.
List specific certifications with their issuing bodies and dates in the 'certifications' section.
Explore advanced cloud ML services (e.g., AWS SageMaker) and add them to skills.
Develop a project that involves deploying an ML model as an API or web service.
overall_feedback: Dipal has a strong academic foundation and relevant internships/projects for an entry-level role in Machine Learning, particularly in model development and data processing. To transition effectively into an ML Engineer role, the focus should be on acquiring and demonstrating skills in MLOps, model deployment, and building production-ready, scalable ML systems, while also quantifying past achievements.
